name: Kodama
source: Waking up near a meteor crater, the suspicious man with amnesia finds himself connected to a mysterious infant by an unbreakable string and the only clue to his own identity is the name Kodama. Having no idea about what lies ahead of his life, the man goes on a journey to get his memory back while helping the six flowers to protect Milsant from misfortunes.
